title:
Base type for all "fast data" - i.e. high volume / high velocity data. Type system will optimize implicitly by
making all primitives required and packing collections of DataPoint by default.

If numeric primitive needs to represent `null` i.e. empty value use `!?` modifier. In which case setting `null` will
be represented as `NaN` and will be skipped during serialization.

Note that `!?` for boolean or exact numeric types like `int` will cause Metadata Issue.

Use `?` modifier for fields that are `null`-able but it is recommended to use it only for field that have mostly
`null` values. Prefer usage of `!?` over `?` or represent `null` state using enum or boolean field.
